result.notes: Coverage is largely supported by D041 and D040. I made one wording change in other_conditions: the documents say replacement units under LAMC 151.28 are covered 'as well as' pre-1978 properties. They do not literally say 'regardless of build date', so that phrase is now 'also covered'. construction_cutoff.basis remains year_built, since D041 says 'first built'; the documents do not mention a certificate of occupancy. min_units is left null: the documents list covered building types (duplexes, two or more single-family dwellings on one parcel) but give no explicit unit-count threshold. Landlord-conduct items (utility and dependent add-ons, surcharges) are not coverage and are excluded.
